title: synthesis result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Design/synthesis/result.json. On status=pass, stage_specific.ppa_actual carries area and timing_slack (one record each; power_mw lives in power-analysis) and stage_specific.requirements[] one verdict per requirements.json row synthesis judges. On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below): the one-line cause, which on a run that produced nothing gradeable is all there is. Carrying requirements[] obliges ppa_actual with it (dependentRequired), so a verdict never travels without the measurements behind it; an early fail carries neither, because no gate ran.

fix_owner.description: On status=fail: the rule that must act, named by this stage from what it read in the raw tool output. Deliberately NOT an enum — the derived input closure in rules.py is the only authority on which names are legal, and decide checks it there. Naming this stage itself (its in-stage remedy is exhausted) or naming nobody both mean a human decides.

requirements.description: One entry per requirements.json row this stage judges: the script's verdict for a row with a target, the agent's (finalize --requirements) for the rest. finalize refuses an envelope that leaves any such row out, so a row nobody read cannot pass as silence.
